API error responses must not disclose exception messages, stack traces, or internal exception objects.

What the Standard says

OWASP API Security identifies verbose errors and internal exception disclosure as security misconfiguration. read it here.

Why it matters

Enforcing this rule gives callers and maintainers one predictable contract and makes drift visible during the build. The analyser proves this specific source-level condition; it does not replace runtime acceptance or security testing.

Bad code example

// Violates OWASP0001
catch (Exception exception) { return BadRequest(exception); }

Good code example

// Follows OWASP0001
catch (Exception) { return Problem(statusCode: 500, detail: "The request could not be processed."); }
